title: Breaking New Ground
description: Steps: - Follow Rex - Clear the Area - Search Drone - Use a Tourniquet - Move Rex To Safety - Head into the Village and Look for Medical - Find and Use a Medkit - Head towards the signal - Find a Vantage Spot to Scout - Sneak into the Canal - Infiltrate the Re-education Facility - Find the Drone Black Box - Access the Black Box - Get to Exfil

title: Operation Critical Extraction
description: Location: Mirae General Hospital Mission Briefing: Intel confirms a High Value Target is recovering in the hospital. Locate and secure him for extraction. Let's find out what the enemy was protecting him for. Threat Assessment: Medium Recommended Gear: 2-Plate Armor Vest, Medkit Main Objectives: - Locate the HVT - Eliminate any Resistance - Extract the HVT Rewards: - x1 Mirae Electrical Room Key - x1 [Defibrillator Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055856) - x25,000 Cash

title: Operation Shopping Hacks
description: Location: Nurigo Mall Mission Briefing: The shopping district is home to Lieutenant Jang-ui's encampment, a potential hot spot for the enemy's weapons program... Threat Assessment: Medium Recommended Gear: 2-Plate Armor Vest, Medkit, Night Vision Goggles Main Objectives: - Hack the Network - Reprogram the Protocol - Secure any Evidence Rewards: - x1 Coin Mining Den Key - x1 Night Vision Goggles - x25,000 Cash

title: Operation Silent Ledger
description: Location: Cheongun Village Mission Briefing: The enemy is using stolen printing plates to bankroll their operations... Threat Assessment: Medium Recommended Gear: 2-Plate Armor Vest, Medkit Main Objectives: - Enter the Casino - Breach the Vault - Secure the Plates Rewards: - x1 Gold Bar - x1 Counting Room Vault Key - x1 Polaris Dagor A1 - x25,000 Cash

description: Orders: - Gear Up - Equip a Weapon, a Backpack, an Armor Vest, and a Medkit from Your Stash - Crackshot - Knock Down 3 Firing Range Targets - First Op - Deploy to DMZ in Dynamic Ops Rewards: - x1 Medkit - x1 2-Plate Armor Vest - x20,000 Cash

title: Human Intel Page 1
description: Orders: 1. Hunter - Locate and Climb a [Hunt Lieutenant Tower](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=lieutenant_hunt_tower%20%26%26%20category%3A28417) - Use the Terminal at the Top to Locate the Nearest Lieutenant 2. Triage Protocol - Head to a [Clinic](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=clinic%20%26%26%20category%3A28418) - Loot a Bandage - Loot 30 Chemicals 3. No One Left - Clear a [Compound](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=compound%20%26%26%20category%3A28422) - Loot Dropped Medical Extraction Intel Found After Clearing a Compound Rewards: - x1 [Flash Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055831) - x20,000 Cash - x1 Basic Triage Kit

title: Human Intel Page 2
description: Orders: - Blindness - Print 4 Flash Grenades - Kill 8 Flashed Enemies - Payment Due - Collect a Dynamic Op Phone - Earn $11,500 Cash from Completing Dynamic Ops - Operation Critical Extraction - Complete the [Operation Critical Extraction](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055616) story mission Rewards: - x3 UAV - x20,000 Cash - x1 Operator Rescue Beacon - x1 Weapon Insurance Contract

title: DMZ Orders Page 5
description: Orders: - Operation Rewards - Collect a Dynamic Op in Cheongun Village - Complete a Dynamic Op - Loot a Dynamic Op Crate - Preparation - Print a Medium Backpack - Print a 2-Plate Armor Vest - Work Quietly - Gunsmith a Suppressor Onto a Weapon - Print a Throwing Knife - Kill 8 Enemies in a Row Without Being Damaged Rewards: - x1 Medium Backpack - x1 Ammo Box - x20,000 Cash

title: Counterfeit Page 1
description: Orders: - Hostile Force - Locate and Enter a [Police Station](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=police_station%20%26%26%20category%3A28415) - Search 3 Containers in a Police Station - Eliminate 5 Soldiers While Inside a Police Station - Robbery - Open a Safe (Often Found in [Compounds](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=compound%20%26%26%20category%3A28422) and Locked Spaces) - Extract $5,000 Total Backpack and Loadout Value - Execute Intel - Hack a [UAV Tower in Deadtown](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055775) - Kill 5 NK Soldiers Pinged by a UAV Tower - Loot Counterfeit Cash Dropped by Pinged NK Soldiers Rewards: - x1 [Recon Drone Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055858) - x20,000 Cash - x1 Explosives Equipment Kit

title: Counterfeit Page 2
description: Orders: - Suit Breach - Kill 15 Enemies in Hazmat Suits (Often Found in Irradiated Areas) - Eyes Everywhere - Print a Recon Drone - Mark 10 Enemies in the [Heavenly Luck Casino](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055917) With a Recon Drone - Operation Silent Ledger - Complete the [Operation Silent Ledger](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055619) Story Mission Rewards: - x20,000 Cash - x1 Operator Rescue Beacon - x1 Weapon Insurance Contract

title: DMZ Orders Page 7
description: Orders: - Recognition - Kill 15 Enemies With an Unsuppressed Weapon in a High Threat Level Location - Radiation Station - Locate a [Fire Station](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=fire_station%20%26%26%20category%3A28416) - Loot 3 Gas Masks or Radiation Pill Bottles - Search 5 Containers While in Radiation - Healer - Track the Medkit Recipe in the 3D Printer - Print a Medkit Rewards: - x1 UAV - x1 Armor Box - x20,000 Cash

title: Underground Page 1
description: Orders: - Eye in the Sky - Commandeer a [SAM Site](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055776) - Shoot Down a Chopper Carrying Cargo With a SAM Site - Loot a Crate From a Downed Chopper - Watch for Bumps - Steal an Enemy Vehicle - Refuel and Repair a Vehicle at a [Gas Station](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=gas_station%20%26%26%20category%3A28414) - Run Over 7 Enemies in a Vehicle - Triangulation - Place a Transmitter on Top of 2 [Radio Towers](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=radio_tower%20%26%26%20category%3A28432) - Place a Transmitter on Top of La Grande Vie in Songdo Wharf Rewards: - x1 [DDOS Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055857) - x1 [Decoy Grenade Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055832) - x1 [Weak Night Vision Goggles Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?locationIds=1055872) - x20,000 Cash

title: DMZ Orders Page 10
description: Orders: - Crashed Crate - Retrieve 3 Lost Supply Drops - Complete a Loot [Radio Tower](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/maps/hajin-dmz?search=radio_tower%20%26%26%20category%3A28432) Side Op - Surprise Me - Complete 5 Dynamic Ops - Complete a Story Mission Using the Random Mission Deploy - Healer - Print or Extract 3 Reactive Metals (Often Found in Garages and Construction Areas) - Extract 30 Metals - Print an Armor Box Rewards: - x1 Large Backpack - x20,000 Cash - x1 Basic Triage Kit

title: DMZ Orders Page 11
